title: Figures 13-14: Army Mobile Tactical Unit and Air Force Airborne Laser Laboratory
description: Two color photographs side by side. Figure 13, "Army Mobile Tactical Unit," shows a tracked military vehicle with a domed beam director in a grassy field, with inset photos of a helicopter and a small drone aircraft. Figure 14, "Air Force Airborne Laser Laboratory," shows a KC-135-type aircraft marked "U.S. AIR FORCE" in flight. Text discusses early DoD laser weapon demonstrations.
